audits.scope: Exact listed three-season cases and June21 two-point sparse local official clone diagnostic, 168h/2m/24-24-24h. No full-region or operational claim.

run_selection.selection_rule: Include all frozen case strata and every clone; retain prior rejected technical run. No adverse outcome exclusion.

check_results.rationale: Rules and strata frozen before new queries; clone representation correction frozen before clone calculations, adverse outcomes retained.
Continuous geometry metrics use unchanged constraints; Python/JS agree within floating tolerance, source times and complete epochs verified.
Identical duration, height and thresholds; location/time/ray changes separately isolated for new cases.
All eight selected, four unavailable strata, first rejected clone run, all ten clone outcomes and negative flips retained.
Outcome-stratified cases and five fixed clones cannot establish population or probability coverage.
Actual individual-observer ephemerides and isolated geometry layers; clone ground and occluders treated jointly, regional omission explicit.
Exact upstream queries, timestamps, versions and hashes retained; original terrain hashes match prior audit.
Published input/algorithm hashes preserved; frozen case hash tied to runner; this is repository continuity, not external immutability.
Same development team performs evaluation; shared terrain and physical model, no independent truth or advancement authority.

independence.evidence: A separate Python integrator and production JS agree; same team/model/data, no external or operational independence.

limitations: Actual predicted ephemerides, not live observations.
Five-minute and denser rays remain approximate and use the same measured DEM.
Added angle is deterministic stress, not official terrain uncertainty.
Unmatched dates/parameters/hashes and missing strata remain unaudited.
New matrix dense checks cover selected points, not all nine surrounding positions.
5 of 100 official realizations, selected by fixed ID: no probabilities, quantiles or confidence coverage.
2 of 18 prior audited locations only: no claim about nine-point whole-footprint worst case.
Same source model and own runner; not independent external validation.
0.5 degree azimuth, refined radial sampling; finite ray/DEM and 5-minute cadence limitations remain.

predecessor_failures.rationale: Initial error-field assumption and WKT-name mismatch rejected before scientific calculation; official semantics and numeric-grid checks corrected with dated appendix.
Dec critical and all short-window strata empty under frozen criteria; no replacement outcomes invented.

audits.minimum_corrective_action: Audit short-event cases with predeclared additional sampling, full official ensemble and regional covariance; obtain independent domain review before stronger claims.
audits.claim_text: Measure, without assuming agreement, how recorded geometric visibility decisions change under real denser ephemerides, individual observer coordinates, and controlled terrain-ray refinement.
